title: Needn't have, might as well, could have

theory.md: **needn't have + V3** — сделал, хотя было не нужно: You **needn't have brought** a gift. **didn't need to** — не делал, потому что было не нужно. **might as well** — можно и… (раз ничего лучше нет): We **might as well** walk. **could have + V3** — мог бы (упрёк): You **could have** told me!

cells: I needn't have cooked: they ate out.
We might as well go home.

theory.md: Needn't have + V3 значит, что действие было. Didn't need to обычно значит, что его не было.

examples.es: You needn't have waited for me.
The bus isn't coming. We might as well walk.
examples.ru: Автобуса нет. Можно и пешком пойти.

examples.es: You could have told me about the swamp!
examples.ru: Мог бы и сказать мне про болото!

examples.es: I didn't need to pay: it was free.

options: You needn't have brought an umbrella.
You didn't need bring an umbrella.
You mustn't have brought an umbrella.

exercises.sentence: You ___ have phoned! I was worried.
exercises.ru: Мог бы и позвонить! Я волновался.

exercises.sentence: I ___ need to take a taxi: Sam drove me.
exercises.ru: Брать такси не пришлось: Сэм меня подвёз.

exercises.statement: «I needn't have hurried» значит, что я торопился зря.
«We might as well go» — грубый приказ.

exercises.sentence: You ___ (not need / buy) bread, we had plenty.
exercises.ru: Зря ты купил хлеб, его было полно.

exercises.sentence: You needn't have bring flowers, but thank you.
exercises.ru: Не стоило приносить цветы, но спасибо.

exercises.sentence: We might as well take the bus.
options: There is no better option, so let us take the bus.
We should never take the bus.
exercises.explain: might as well — «раз ничего лучше нет».

exercises.source: It wasn't necessary for you to wait, but you did.
